2026-07-27.ai: The bill for the weekend came due: Nvidia's guarantee met a skeptical market (NVDA −4%, CDS wider, "circular" the dominant frame), CXMT's 466% debut made it the most valuable China-listed company at ~$489B — dragging Micron −8% and ASML down on China news — and SpaceX ground to a fresh all-time low near $100. Against that tape the frontier kept shipping: Kimi K3 confirmed downloadable, Opus 5 setting records into Microsoft's own Copilot, and Altman scheduled into Washington for the 08-01 week.
2026-07-27.mental-health: The evidence question led the day: new research finding AI "remains a liability" for most mental-health conditions landed the same morning the OpenAI health-advice liability suit (the embolism case) kept generating coverage — the rigor gap and the harm docket converging on the same question from two sides. The governance mechanism story also sharpened: state AGs are regulating chatbots with *existing* consumer-protection law, not waiting for statutes.
2026-07-27.money: The guarantee met the market and the market flinched: NVDA slipped ~4% with its CDS widening as "circular financing" became the dominant frame (Axios, Breakingviews, Chanos) — the guarantor's own credit is now the story. Meanwhile CXMT's +466% debut made it mainland China's most valuable listed company, Brent fell 5–10% as the US and Iran paused strikes, and SpaceX hit a fresh all-time low into a hawkish-tilted FOMC week.

2026-07-28.ai: The market is repricing the lender: Nvidia's CDS printed a record single-day move as the OpenAI guarantee firmed to $250B (WSJ tier-1; the $500B headline resolved as the Ohio site's TOTAL cost, not the guarantee) — while Nvidia committed $5B to pre-product SSI and entered talks to backstop a 10GW Ohio megasite. Korea's session crashed through circuit breakers on China-chip fear, straight into the FOMC + four-print earnings gauntlet — and Meta formalized a $14B off-balance-sheet JV with BlackRock the day before its own print.
2026-07-28.mental-health: The afternoon filled in what the morning called quiet: Bloomberg surveyed the whole chatbot-liability docket in one feature, UnitedHealth's own earnings boast ("AI runs virtually everything," 96% first-pass approval) landed in the same quarter it fights discovery over algorithmic denials — and the SB 903 ledger entry turned out to be aimed at a hearing that had already happened: the real gate is Appropriations, 08-14. Then the day closed on the thing the map had missed entirely: **at midnight, Maine became the first state where a statute barring AI-delivered therapy is actually in force** — not pending, not signed, live. And xAI spent the same evening suing a state attorney general to stop a different AI-harm law from taking effect.
2026-07-28.money: The credit market moved from soft-no to loud-no: Nvidia's CDS printed a record single-day widening as the $250B guarantee firmed, and Korea crashed through circuit breakers — the AI bear-turn's two legs (US credit, Asia equity) converging the day before FOMC. The panel still said leak, not crack: HY OAS 2.81%, just +4bp over three sessions.
2026-07-28.front: The Iran-US conflict re-escalated and reached the buildout on the same day. Iran fired ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan at 5:45pm ET — all intercepted, the first such attack since the 07-24 pause — and satellite imagery published the same day corroborated earlier Iranian strikes on two Amazon data centres in Bahrain, the first war in which commercial compute infrastructure has been deliberately targeted with published damage assessment. Oil reversed on the strike, Brent +4.3% to about $87.7, re-arming the inflation impulse hours before a Fed decision that markets cannot price consistently: CME reads a hike near twice as likely as the prediction markets do. In memory, SK Hynix posted the largest operating profit in its history and still missed consensus, and Korea round-tripped the news into its second circuit breaker in two sessions — a market that cannot hold a bid on the best print in the cycle. Underneath it, Reuters reported that China has begun mass-producing its own immersion DUV lithography tool, with named recipients and a unit target, which is the first testable challenge to the chokepoint the whole export-control picture rests on. In mental health, Maine became the first US state where a statute barring AI-delivered therapy is actually in force, and xAI sued a state attorney general to stop a different AI-harm law taking effect.

flash.headline: Iran fired ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan, breaking the four-day pause
flash.body: Iran's Revolutionary Guard fired ballistic missiles at a US air base and a US Central Command facility in Jordan at 5:45pm ET; CENTCOM said all were intercepted and reported no casualties, calling it "an attempted surprise attack." It is the first Iranian ballistic-missile attack on a US base since the 07-24 pause, and oil reversed on it — Brent +4.3% to ~$87.7 — hours before the FOMC decision.
